alkylation reagent: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA) and incubation was performed for 5 min at 70 °C.
alkylation concentration: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA) and incubation was performed for 5 min at 70 °C.
cleavage agent: Proteins bound to the GFP-Trap®_A beads were digested using trypsin and the peptides were analysed by LC-MS/MS.
collision energy: HCD fragmentation with normalised collision energy of 33
enrichment method: Immunoprecipitation was performed using GFP-Trap®_A Kit (Chromotek) following the manufacturer’s instructions.
fractionation method: Reversed phase chromatography was used to separate tryptic peptides prior to mass spectrometric analysis.
fragmentation method: HCD fragmentation with normalised collision energy of 33
instrument: analysed on a Thermo Orbitrap Fusion (Q-OT-qIT, Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: Eluting peptides were converted to gas-phase ions by means of electrospray ionisation
labeling: the peptides were analysed by LC-MS/MS.
reduction reagent: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA) and incubation was performed for 5 min at 70 °C.
reduction concentration: We added 10 mM TCEP (Tris-(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (CAA) and incubation was performed for 5 min at 70 °C.
